scripts.db: node --input-type=module --eval "import db from './src/db/client.js'; console.table(db.prepare('SELECT id,title,score,status,applicants,how_long,city FROM jobs ORDER BY found_at DESC LIMIT 50').all())"
scripts.db:applied: node --input-type=module --eval "import db from './src/db/client.js'; console.table(db.prepare(\"SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE status='applied'\").all())"
scripts.db:stats: node --input-type=module --eval "import db from './src/db/client.js'; console.table(db.prepare(\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM jobs GROUP BY status\").all())"
scripts.db:links: node --input-type=module --eval "import db from './src/db/client.js'; db.prepare('SELECT id,title,link,score FROM jobs ORDER BY score DESC').all().forEach(j => console.log('['+j.id+'] '+j.score+'/100 | '+j.title+'\n    '+j.link+'\n'))"
